title: Pricing change storyboard for model sunset and compatibility guides
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and produce onboarding/quickstart visuals and release-note screenshots that clearly communicate: (1) new model launches with quick compatibility notes, (2) model deprecation / sunset notices with migration guidance, and (3) pricing tier changes that affect model selection. Deliverables should be ready for product release notes, console banners, and docs embeds.
deliverables: Figma master file (pages: Hero Announcement, Pricing Comparison Modal - desktop + mobile, Sunset Banner variants, Migration Tiles, Release Note Storyboard)
Export-ready PNG/SVG assets (2x and 3x) for web and email
Annotated screenshot pack (with alt text and copy snippets) for engineering and docs
One-line and extended copy variants for UI banners, modal headers, and release notes
Accessibility spec: contrast ratios, font sizes, focus states, keyboard flows
acceptance_criteria: All visual variants exported to Drive and linked in this ticket
Design sign-off from PM (PM-4120) and engineering leads (ENG-8801)
Release-note markdown includes final screenshots and copy
QA screenshots validated on staging console at responsive breakpoints
Assets include localized copy placeholders and are labeled for i18n
comments: 2026-03-05 Maya Chen: Kickoff - scoped deliverables with PM. Focus: make deprecation messaging clear without alarming users. Prioritize two banner styles: 'soft sunset' and 'critical sunset'.
2026-03-07 Liam O'Connor: First Figma pass uploaded. Created Hero and Pricing Modal templates. Need exact tokenized prices from PM before finalizing hierarchy.
2026-03-08 Priya Rao (PM): Added pricing table CSV in Confluence and noted billing model changes for reserved capacity customers. Provided migration note copy for sunset flows.
2026-03-09 Design review: Accessibility flagged low contrast on secondary pill. Updated color tokens and re-uploaded variants (v1.1).
2026-03-11 Engineering review (ENG-8801): Requested smaller file sizes for hero PNG (use SVG where possible) and provided CSS constraints for modal width on small screens.
2026-03-12 Liam O'Connor: Prepared annotated screenshot pack and uploaded exports to Drive. Awaiting final PM sign-off to finalize release notes screenshots.
qa_checklist: Capture screenshots on staging (desktop 1440, tablet 768, mobile 375)
Verify alt text and copy match release-note markdown
Run contrast check for all text elements (WCAG AA minimum)
Confirm modal behavior: can dismiss, focus is trapped, keyboard accessible
Confirm images load from CDN and are <200KB where SVG not possible
notes: Design goal: balance urgency of sunset messaging with clear next steps; avoid causing unnecessary churn.
Consider A/B of 'migration tile' CTA wording: 'Start migration' vs 'View compatibility guide' — recommend usability quicktest during rollout.
Localization: leave room for translations in modal and banner; avoid tight horizontal constraints for languages like German.
If pricing tiers change, coordinate with growth/legal for wording review (PM action item).
Related tickets: reference ENG-8801 for frontend integration and PM-2333 for billing copy updates.
